sloka: जाम्बवांश्च सुषेणश्च ऋषभश्च महामतिः ।दुर्मुखश्च महातेजास्तथा शतबलिः कपिः ।। ६-३८-१२।।
transliteration: jāmbavāṁśca suṣeṇaśca ṛṣabhaśca mahāmatiḥ ।durmukhaśca mahātejāstathā śatabaliḥ kapiḥ ।। 6-38-12।।

translations.english: Hanuman, Angada, Neela, Mainda, Dwivida, Gandhamadana, Panasa, Kumuda, Hara. Rambhu, Jambhavan, Sushena, intelligent Rshaba, highly energetic Durmukha and Satavali and similarly swift footed Vanaras, mountain rangers and those who can move at wind speed, all of them in hundreds ascended the Suvela mountain following Rama.
